def normalized_values(value: Any) -> set[str]:
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return {
            str(item).strip().lower()
            for item in value
            if str(item if item is not None else "").strip()
        }
    text = str(value if value is not None else "").strip().lower()
    return {text} if text else set()


def normalized_query(trace: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str]:
    query = _case_query(trace)
    return {
        key: str(query.get(key) or "").strip().lower()
        for key in ("issue_type", "vendor", "system", "region", "band")
    }


def query_key(query: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return tuple(query[key] for key in ("issue_type", "vendor", "system", "region", "band"))


def percentile(values: list[int | float], quantile: float) -> float | None:
    if not values:
        return None
    ordered = sorted(float(value) for value in values)
    rank = max(1, math.ceil(quantile * len(ordered)))
    return ordered[rank - 1]


def distribution(values: Iterable[int | float]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rows = [float(value) for value in values]
    return {
        "count": len(rows),
        "mean": statistics.fmean(rows) if rows else None,
        "median": statistics.median(rows) if rows else None,
        "p90": percentile(rows, 0.90),
        "min": min(rows) if rows else None,
        "max": max(rows) if rows else None,
    }


def memory_reference(
    memory_path: Path,
    raw_summary: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    frozen = raw_summary["artifacts"]["pilot_memory_objects"]
    actual_sha = sha256_path(memory_path)
    if actual_sha != frozen["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Pilot memory artifact SHA differs from the frozen raw audit")
    return {
        "path": str(memory_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "sha256": actual_sha,
        "rows": int(frozen["rows"]),
        "frozen_by": raw_summary["schema_version"],
    }


def validate_dependency(
    *,
    config: dict[str, Any],
    config_path: Path,
    raw_summary: dict[str, Any],
    raw_summary_path: Path,
    source_path: Path,
    temporal: dict[str, Any],
    targets: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    selected = str(raw_summary.get("selection", {}).get("selected_protocol") or "")
    expected = str(config["depends_on"]["selected_raw_generator"])
    if selected != expected:
        raise ValueError(f"frozen raw generator mismatch: {selected!r} != {expected!r}")
    actual_source_sha = sha256_path(source_path)
    frozen_source_sha = raw_summary["sources"]["train_trace_records"]["sha256"]
    if actual_source_sha != frozen_source_sha:
        raise ValueError("train source SHA differs from the frozen raw audit")

    raw_temporal = raw_summary["temporal_view"]
    current_pilot_ids = sorted(row["trace_id"] for row in temporal["pilot_rows"])
    current_policy_ids = sorted(row["trace_id"] for row in temporal["policy_rows"])
    if current_pilot_ids != raw_temporal["pilot_trace_ids"]:
        raise ValueError("reconstructed Pilot trace manifest differs from raw audit")
    if current_policy_ids != raw_temporal["policy_development_trace_ids"]:
        raise ValueError("reconstructed policy trace manifest differs from raw audit")
    target_ids = sorted(str(item["trace"].get("trace_id") or "") for item in targets)
    if target_ids != raw_summary["target_manifest"]["trace_ids"]:
        raise ValueError("reconstructed target manifest differs from raw audit")
    return {
        "raw_audit_summary": {
            "path": str(raw_summary_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "sha256": sha256_path(raw_summary_path),
            "schema_version": raw_summary["schema_version"],
        },
        "train_trace_records": {
            "path": str(source_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "sha256": actual_source_sha,
        },
        "config": {
            "path": str(config_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "sha256": sha256_path(config_path),
        },
    }


def precompute_cases(
    cases: list[dict[str, Any]],
    pilot_by_trace: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    source_actions: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, Any]],
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, list[int]]], dict[str, Any]]:
    records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    postings: dict[str, dict[str, list[int]]] = {
        field: defaultdict(list)
        for field in ("issue_types", "vendors", "systems", "regions", "bands")
    }
    reasons: Counter[str] = Counter()
    for index, case in enumerate(cases):
        case_id = str(case.get("memory_id") or "")
        trace_ids = case.get("trace_ids") if isinstance(case.get("trace_ids"), list) else []
        source_trace_id = str(trace_ids[0] if trace_ids else "")
        projected_action = _case_action(
            case,
            action_admission_policy="realized_action_scope_v1",
        )
        source_action_id = str(projected_action.get("source_action_id") or "")
        source_trace = pilot_by_trace.get(source_trace_id)
        source_action = source_actions.get((source_trace_id, source_action_id))
        action = (
            enrich_action(projected_action, source_trace, source_action)
            if source_trace is not None and source_action is not None
            else dict(projected_action)
        )
        applicability = (
            case.get("applicability")
            if isinstance(case.get("applicability"), dict)
            else {}
        )
        invalid_reason = ""
        if not case_id:
            invalid_reason = "missing_case_memory_id"
        elif not action.get("scheme_id"):
            invalid_reason = "no_admitted_case_action"
        elif source_trace is None:
            invalid_reason = "source_trace_not_in_pilot_authority"
        elif source_action is None:
            invalid_reason = "source_action_unresolved"
        elif not _structural_candidate_action_admissible(source_action):
            invalid_reason = "source_action_admission_violation"
        if invalid_reason:
            reasons[invalid_reason] += 1
        action_id = (
            candidate_action_id(action, applicability=applicability)
            if not invalid_reason
            else ""
        )
        record = {
            "index": index,
            "case_id": case_id,
            "case": case,
            "source_trace_id": source_trace_id,
            "source_action_id": source_action_id,
            "action": action,
            "applicability": applicability,
            "candidate_action_id": action_id,
            "identity": (
                candidate_action_identity(action, applicability=applicability)
                if action_id
                else None
            ),
            "valid": not invalid_reason,
            "invalid_reason": invalid_reason,
        }
        records.append(record)
        for app_field in postings:
            for value in normalized_values(applicability.get(app_field)):
                postings[app_field][value].append(index)
    return records, postings, {
        "case_count": len(records),
        "valid_case_count": sum(bool(record["valid"]) for record in records),
        "invalid_case_count": sum(not record["valid"] for record in records),
        "invalid_reasons": dict(sorted(reasons.items())),
    }


def ranked_positive_case_indices(
    query: dict[str, str],
    records: list[dict[str, Any]],
    postings: dict[str, dict[str, list[int]]],
    retrieval_fields: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> list[tuple[int, float]]:
    scores: dict[int, float] = defaultdict(float)
    for spec in retrieval_fields:
        value = query[str(spec["query"])]
        if not value:
            continue
        for index in postings[str(spec["applicability"])].get(value, []):
            scores[index] += float(spec["weight"])
    return sorted(
        scores.items(),
        key=lambda item: (-item[1], records[item[0]]["case_id"]),
    )


def append_source(candidate: dict[str, Any], record: dict[str, Any], rank: int) -> None:
    case_id = record["case_id"]
    if case_id in candidate["source_case_ids"]:
        return
    candidate["source_case_ids"].append(case_id)
    candidate["source_case_ranks"].append(rank)
    candidate["source_trace_ids"].append(record["source_trace_id"])
    candidate["source_action_ids"].append(record["source_action_id"])


def build_unique_pool(
    *,
    query: dict[str, str],
    records: list[dict[str, Any]],
    ranked: list[tuple[int, float]],
    maximum_unique_pool_size: int,
    memory_sha: str,
    ks: list[int],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    pool_id = stable_id(
        "pool",
        {"query": query, "memory_sha256": memory_sha, "identity": CANDIDATE_ACTION_IDENTITY_VERSION},
    )
    candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    by_action_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    route_action_ids: set[str] = set()
    invalid_all: Counter[str] = Counter()
    invalid_prefix: Counter[str] = Counter()
    duplicate_prefix_count = 0
    depth_to_k: dict[str, int | None] = {f"at_{k}": None for k in ks}
    pool_stop_depth: int | None = None

    for rank, (index, score) in enumerate(ranked, start=1):
        record = records[index]
        if not record["valid"]:
            invalid_all[record["invalid_reason"]] += 1
            if pool_stop_depth is None:
                invalid_prefix[record["invalid_reason"]] += 1
            continue
        action_id = record["candidate_action_id"]
        route_action_ids.add(action_id)
        if pool_stop_depth is not None:
            continue
        if action_id in by_action_id:
            duplicate_prefix_count += 1
            append_source(by_action_id[action_id], record, rank)
            continue
        candidate = {
            "rank": len(candidates) + 1,
            "candidate_action_id": action_id,
            "identity": record["identity"],
            "action": record["action"],
            "first_case_rank": rank,
            "structured_case_score": score,
            "primary_source_case_id": record["case_id"],
            "primary_source_trace_id": record["source_trace_id"],
            "primary_source_action_id": record["source_action_id"],
            "source_case_ids": [],
            "source_case_ranks": [],
            "source_trace_ids": [],
            "source_action_ids": [],
        }
        append_source(candidate, record, rank)
        candidates.append(candidate)
        by_action_id[action_id] = candidate
        unique_count = len(candidates)
        for k in ks:
            if unique_count >= k and depth_to_k[f"at_{k}"] is None:
                depth_to_k[f"at_{k}"] = rank
        if unique_count >= maximum_unique_pool_size:
            pool_stop_depth = rank

    scan_depth = pool_stop_depth if pool_stop_depth is not None else len(ranked)
    return {
        "pool_id": pool_id,
        "query": query,
        "positive_case_count": len(ranked),
        "positive_route_valid_case_count": sum(
            1 for index, _ in ranked if records[index]["valid"]
        ),
        "positive_route_invalid_case_count": sum(invalid_all.values()),
        "positive_route_invalid_reasons": dict(sorted(invalid_all.items())),
        "routable_observed_action_space_size": len(route_action_ids),
        "maximum_unique_pool_size": maximum_unique_pool_size,
        "unique_candidate_count": len(candidates),
        "pool_fraction_of_routable_action_space": (
            len(candidates) / len(route_action_ids) if route_action_ids else None
        ),
        "raw_case_scan_depth": scan_depth,
        "depth_to_unique_k": depth_to_k,
        "duplicate_case_hits_before_pool_stop": duplicate_prefix_count,
        "invalid_case_hits_before_pool_stop": sum(invalid_prefix.values()),
        "invalid_reasons_before_pool_stop": dict(sorted(invalid_prefix.items())),
        "candidates": candidates,
    }


def feedback_view(
    *,
    candidate: dict[str, Any],
    target_trace: dict[str, Any],
    memories: list[dict[str, Any]],
    memory_by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    memory_sha: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    evidence = _candidate_strategy_evidence(
        candidate["action"],
        target_trace,
        memories,
        selection_policy="structural_relation_v1",
    )
    strategy_ids = [
        str(item.get("memory_id") or "")
        for item in evidence
        if item.get("memory_id")
    ]
    source_case_ids = list(candidate["source_case_ids"])
    ordered_memory_ids = source_case_ids + [
        memory_id for memory_id in strategy_ids if memory_id not in source_case_ids
    ]
    missing_ids = [memory_id for memory_id in ordered_memory_ids if memory_id not in memory_by_id]
    trace_id = str(target_trace.get("trace_id") or "")
    complete = bool(source_case_ids) and not missing_ids
    view_id = stable_id(
        "feedback",
        {
            "contract": "candidate_feedback_view.v1",
            "target_trace_id": trace_id,
            "candidate_action_id": candidate["candidate_action_id"],
            "source_case_ids": source_case_ids,
            "strategy_playbook_memory_ids": strategy_ids,
            "memory_sha256": memory_sha,
        },
    )
    return {
        "feedback_view_id": view_id,
        "contract": "candidate_feedback_view.v1",
        "status": "mapped" if complete else "unmapped",
        "source_case_memory_ids": source_case_ids,
        "source_case_count": len(source_case_ids),
        "strategy_playbook_memory_ids": strategy_ids,
        "strategy_playbook_memory_types": [
            str(memory_by_id[memory_id].get("memory_type") or "")
            for memory_id in strategy_ids
            if memory_id in memory_by_id
        ],
        "strategy_playbook_count": len(strategy_ids),
        "ordered_memory_ids": ordered_memory_ids,
        "memory_count": len(ordered_memory_ids),
        "missing_memory_ids": missing_ids,
        "selection_policy": "structural_relation_v1",
    }


def evaluate_target(
    *,
    target: dict[str, Any],
    pool: dict[str, Any],
    memories: list[dict[str, Any]],
    memory_by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    memory_sha: str,
    ks: list[int],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    trace = target["trace"]
    ticket = trace.get("ticket") if isinstance(trace.get("ticket"), dict) else {}
    trace_id = str(trace.get("trace_id") or "")
    candidate_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    prior_actions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    hits: list[bool] = []
    for candidate in pool["candidates"]:
        result = best_action_equivalence(
            candidate["action"],
            target["gold_actions"],
            ticket=ticket,
        )
        level = str((result or {}).get("level") or "unverifiable")
        hit = level in {"strongly_verifiable", "weakly_verifiable"}
        redundant_result = (
            best_action_equivalence(candidate["action"], prior_actions, ticket=ticket)
            if prior_actions
            else None
        )
        redundant_level = str((redundant_result or {}).get("level") or "unverifiable")
        evaluator_redundant = redundant_level in {
            "strongly_verifiable",
            "weakly_verifiable",
        }
        view = feedback_view(
            candidate=candidate,
            target_trace=trace,
            memories=memories,
            memory_by_id=memory_by_id,
            memory_sha=memory_sha,
        )
        candidate_rows.append({
            "rank": candidate["rank"],
            "candidate_action_id": candidate["candidate_action_id"],
            "candidate_instance_id": candidate_instance_id(
                trace_id,
                candidate["candidate_action_id"],
            ),
            "hit": hit,
            "equivalence_level": level,
            "evaluator_equivalent_to_prior_strong_distinct": evaluator_redundant,
            "prior_equivalence_level": redundant_level,
            "feedback_view": view,
        })
        prior_actions.append(candidate["action"])
        hits.append(hit)
    first_hit = next((index + 1 for index, hit in enumerate(hits) if hit), None)
    return {
        "trace_id": trace_id,
        "cohort": target["cohort"],
        "gold_action_count": len(target["gold_actions"]),
        "pool_id": pool["pool_id"],
        "candidate_count": len(candidate_rows),
        "routable_observed_action_space_size": pool["routable_observed_action_space_size"],
        "pool_fraction_of_routable_action_space": pool["pool_fraction_of_routable_action_space"],
        "raw_case_scan_depth": pool["raw_case_scan_depth"],
        "depth_to_unique_k": pool["depth_to_unique_k"],
        "first_hit_rank": first_hit,
        "ceiling": {f"at_{k}": any(hits[:k]) for k in ks},
        "candidate_hit_flags": hits,
        "candidates": candidate_rows,
    }


def aggregate_targets(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], ks: list[int]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    total = len(rows)
    one_shot = sum(bool(row["ceiling"]["at_1"]) for row in rows)
    slots = [candidate for row in rows for candidate in row["candidates"]]
    mapped = sum(candidate["feedback_view"]["status"] == "mapped" for candidate in slots)
    out: dict[str, Any] = {
        "target_count": total,
        "candidate_slot_count": len(slots),
        "OneShot@1": ratio(one_shot, total),
        "feedback_view_mapping": ratio(mapped, len(slots)),
        "source_case_fan_in": distribution(
            candidate["feedback_view"]["source_case_count"] for candidate in slots
        ),
        "strategy_playbook_fan_out": distribution(
            candidate["feedback_view"]["strategy_playbook_count"] for candidate in slots
        ),
        "targets_with_evaluator_equivalent_strong_distinct_redundancy": ratio(
            sum(
                any(
                    candidate["evaluator_equivalent_to_prior_strong_distinct"]
                    for candidate in row["candidates"]
                )
                for row in rows
            ),
            total,
        ),
        "evaluator_equivalent_strong_distinct_slots": ratio(
            sum(
                candidate["evaluator_equivalent_to_prior_strong_distinct"]
                for candidate in slots
            ),
            len(slots),
        ),
        "routable_observed_action_space_size": distribution(
            row["routable_observed_action_space_size"] for row in rows
        ),
        "pool_fraction_of_routable_action_space": distribution(
            row["pool_fraction_of_routable_action_space"]
            for row in rows
            if row["pool_fraction_of_routable_action_space"] is not None
        ),
    }
    for k in ks:
        hits = sum(bool(row["ceiling"][f"at_{k}"]) for row in rows)
        covered = sum(int(row["candidate_count"] >= k) for row in rows)
        recovered = sum(
            bool(not row["ceiling"]["at_1"] and row["ceiling"][f"at_{k}"])
            for row in rows
        )
        depths = [
            row["depth_to_unique_k"][f"at_{k}"]
            for row in rows
            if row["depth_to_unique_k"][f"at_{k}"] is not None
        ]
        out[f"Ceiling@{k}"] = ratio(hits, total)
        out[f"Headroom@{k}"] = {
            "count": hits - one_shot,
            "percentage_points": (hits - one_shot) / total if total else None,
            "definition": f"Ceiling@{k} - OneShot@1",
        }
        out[f"one_shot_miss_recovered_by_{k}"] = ratio(recovered, total - one_shot)
        out[f"pool_coverage_at_least_{k}"] = ratio(covered, total)
        out[f"raw_case_scan_depth_to_{k}_unique"] = distribution(depths)
    return out


def aggregate(
    target_rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    pool_rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    ks: list[int],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "all_targets": aggregate_targets(target_rows, ks),
        "cohorts": {
            cohort: aggregate_targets(
                [row for row in target_rows if row["cohort"] == cohort],
                ks,
            )
            for cohort in ("strict_single", "multi_bundle")
        },
        "unique_query_contexts": {
            "count": len(pool_rows),
            "unique_pool_size": distribution(row["unique_candidate_count"] for row in pool_rows),
            "routable_observed_action_space_size": distribution(
                row["routable_observed_action_space_size"] for row in pool_rows
            ),
            "raw_case_scan_depth": distribution(row["raw_case_scan_depth"] for row in pool_rows),
            "duplicate_case_hits_before_pool_stop": distribution(
                row["duplicate_case_hits_before_pool_stop"] for row in pool_rows
            ),
        },
    }


def choose_k(
    metrics: dict[str, Any],
    selection_rule: dict[str, Any],
    integrity_passed: bool,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    all_targets = metrics["all_targets"]
    cohorts = metrics["cohorts"]
    k10 = selection_rule["k10_eligibility"]
    k5 = selection_rule["k5_fallback_eligibility"]
    mapping_rate = float(all_targets["feedback_view_mapping"]["value"] or 0.0)
    marginal_by_cohort = {
        cohort: float(row["Ceiling@10"]["value"] or 0.0)
        - float(row["Ceiling@5"]["value"] or 0.0)
        for cohort, row in cohorts.items()
    }
    checks10 = {
        "integrity": integrity_passed,
        "all_target_pool_coverage_at_least_10": float(
            all_targets["pool_coverage_at_least_10"]["value"] or 0.0
        ) >= float(k10["all_target_pool_coverage_at_least_10"]),
        "each_cohort_pool_coverage_at_least_10": all(
            float(row["pool_coverage_at_least_10"]["value"] or 0.0)
            >= float(k10["each_cohort_pool_coverage_at_least_10"])
            for row in cohorts.values()
        ),
        "feedback_view_mapping_rate": mapping_rate >= float(k10["feedback_view_mapping_rate"]),
        "marginal_ceiling_at_10_minus_at_5_in_either_cohort": max(
            marginal_by_cohort.values(), default=0.0
        ) >= float(k10["marginal_ceiling_at_10_minus_at_5_in_either_cohort"]),
    }
    checks5 = {
        "integrity": integrity_passed,
        "all_target_pool_coverage_at_least_5": float(
            all_targets["pool_coverage_at_least_5"]["value"] or 0.0
        ) >= float(k5["all_target_pool_coverage_at_least_5"]),
        "each_cohort_pool_coverage_at_least_5": all(
            float(row["pool_coverage_at_least_5"]["value"] or 0.0)
            >= float(k5["each_cohort_pool_coverage_at_least_5"])
            for row in cohorts.values()
        ),
        "feedback_view_mapping_rate": mapping_rate >= float(k5["feedback_view_mapping_rate"]),
    }
    if all(checks10.values()):
        status, selected = "selected_k10_by_frozen_rule", 10
    elif all(checks5.values()):
        status, selected = "selected_k5_by_frozen_fallback_rule", 5
    else:
        status, selected = "phase1_no_go", None
    return {
        "status": status,
        "selected_candidate_pool_size_k": selected,
        "agent_attempt_budget_n_max": None,
        "agent_attempt_budget_status": "pending_phase3_agent_pilot",
        "k10_checks": checks10,
        "k5_checks": checks5,
        "marginal_ceiling_at_10_minus_at_5_by_cohort": marginal_by_cohort,
    }


def percent(value: Any) -> str:
    return "N/A" if value is None else f"{100.0 * float(value):.2f}%"


def number(value: Any) -> str:
    return "N/A" if value is None else f"{float(value):.1f}"

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_CONFIG)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config_path = args.config if args.config.is_absolute() else ROOT / args.config
    config = read_json(config_path)
    source_path = project_path(config["source"]["train_trace_records"])
    source_text = str(source_path).lower()
    if any(token in source_text for token in ("dev", "holdout", "test")):
        raise ValueError(f"Phase 1B refuses non-train source: {source_path}")
    raw_summary_path = project_path(config["depends_on"]["raw_audit_summary"])
    memory_path = project_path(config["depends_on"]["pilot_memory_objects"])
    raw_summary = read_json(raw_summary_path)

    traces = list(cio.read_jsonl(source_path))
    temporal = build_temporal_views(traces, config)
    targets, target_manifest = build_targets(temporal["policy_traces"])
    sources = validate_dependency(
        config=config,
        config_path=config_path,
        raw_summary=raw_summary,
        raw_summary_path=raw_summary_path,
        source_path=source_path,
        temporal=temporal,
        targets=targets,
    )
    memory_ref = memory_reference(memory_path, raw_summary)
    memories = list(cio.read_jsonl(memory_path))
    if len(memories) != memory_ref["rows"]:
        raise ValueError("Pilot memory row count differs from frozen raw audit")
    memory_by_id = {
        str(memory.get("memory_id") or ""): memory
        for memory in memories
        if memory.get("memory_id")
    }
    compiled_cases = [
        memory for memory in memories if memory.get("memory_type") == "case_memory"
    ]

    pilot_authority, authority_manifest = materialize_evidence_authority(
        temporal["pilot_traces"]
    )
    pilot_by_trace = {
        str(trace.get("trace_id") or ""): trace for trace in pilot_authority
    }
    source_actions = {
        (str(trace.get("trace_id") or ""), str(action.get("action_id") or "")): action
        for trace in pilot_authority
        for action in trace.get("actions") or []
        if isinstance(action, dict)
    }
    records, postings, case_manifest = precompute_cases(
        compiled_cases,
        pilot_by_trace,
        source_actions,
    )
    ks = [int(value) for value in config["candidate_pool"]["audit_ks"]]
    maximum = int(config["candidate_pool"]["maximum_unique_pool_size"])

    targets_by_query: dict[tuple[str, ...], list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    query_by_key: dict[tuple[str, ...], dict[str, str]] = {}
    for target in targets:
        query = normalized_query(target["trace"])
        key = query_key(query)
        query_by_key[key] = query
        targets_by_query[key].append(target)

    pool_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    pool_by_key: dict[tuple[str, ...], dict[str, Any]] = {}
    retrieval_fields = config["candidate_pool"]["retrieval_fields"]
    for key in sorted(targets_by_query):
        query = query_by_key[key]
        ranked = ranked_positive_case_indices(query, records, postings, retrieval_fields)
        pool = build_unique_pool(
            query=query,
            records=records,
            ranked=ranked,
            maximum_unique_pool_size=maximum,
            memory_sha=memory_ref["sha256"],
            ks=ks,
        )
        pool_rows.append(pool)
        pool_by_key[key] = pool

    target_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for index, target in enumerate(targets, start=1):
        key = query_key(normalized_query(target["trace"]))
        target_rows.append(evaluate_target(
            target=target,
            pool=pool_by_key[key],
            memories=memories,
            memory_by_id=memory_by_id,
            memory_sha=memory_ref["sha256"],
            ks=ks,
        ))
        if index % 500 == 0:
            print(f"evaluated {index}/{len(targets)} targets", flush=True)

    metrics = aggregate(target_rows, pool_rows, ks)
    target_ids = {row["trace_id"] for row in target_rows}
    pilot_ids = {row["trace_id"] for row in temporal["pilot_rows"]}
    repeated_ids = sum(
        len(row["candidates"])
        - len({candidate["candidate_action_id"] for candidate in row["candidates"]})
        for row in pool_rows
    )
    unmapped_views = sum(
        candidate["feedback_view"]["status"] != "mapped"
        for row in target_rows
        for candidate in row["candidates"]
    )
    selected_source_failures = sum(
        not candidate["source_case_ids"]
        or not candidate["primary_source_trace_id"]
        or not candidate["primary_source_action_id"]
        for row in pool_rows
        for candidate in row["candidates"]
    )
    selected_admission_violations = sum(
        not _structural_candidate_action_admissible(candidate["action"])
        for row in pool_rows
        for candidate in row["candidates"]
    )
    integrity = {
        "pilot_target_trace_overlap_count": len(pilot_ids & target_ids),
        "selected_candidate_source_failure_count": selected_source_failures,
        "selected_candidate_admission_violation_count": selected_admission_violations,
        "repeated_candidate_action_id_count": repeated_ids,
        "unmapped_feedback_view_count": unmapped_views,
        "dev_or_holdout_loaded": False,
    }
    integrity["all_passed"] = (
        integrity["pilot_target_trace_overlap_count"] == 0
        and integrity["selected_candidate_source_failure_count"] == 0
        and integrity["selected_candidate_admission_violation_count"] == 0
        and integrity["repeated_candidate_action_id_count"] == 0
        and integrity["unmapped_feedback_view_count"] == 0
        and not integrity["dev_or_holdout_loaded"]
    )
    selection = choose_k(metrics, config["selection_rule"], integrity["all_passed"])

    output_dir = project_path(config["outputs"]["result_dir"])
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    artifacts = {
        "query_candidate_pools": write_jsonl(
            output_dir / "query_candidate_pools.jsonl",
            pool_rows,
        ),
        "target_candidate_audit": write_jsonl(
            output_dir / "target_candidate_audit.jsonl",
            target_rows,
        ),
    }
    summary = {
        "schema_version": config["schema_version"],
        "protocol_version": config["protocol_version"],
        "created_at": datetime.now(tz=ZoneInfo(config["time_contract"]["timezone"])).isoformat(),
        "git_head": git_head(),
        "sources": {
            **sources,
            "pilot_memory_objects": memory_ref,
            "exporter": {
                "path": str(Path(__file__).resolve().relative_to(ROOT)),
                "sha256": sha256_path(Path(__file__).resolve()),
            },
            "candidate_identity_module": {

def window_boundaries(config: dict[str, Any]) -> list[datetime]:
    tc = config["time_contract"]
    timezone = ZoneInfo(tc["timezone"])
    start = parse_datetime(tc["phase_start"], timezone)
    end = parse_datetime(tc["phase_end"], timezone)
    if start is None or end is None or not start < end:
        raise ValueError("invalid Phase 2 start/end boundary")
    boundaries = [start]
    cursor = start.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
    if cursor <= start:
        cursor += timedelta(days=1)
    while cursor.weekday() != 0:
        cursor += timedelta(days=1)
    while cursor < end:
        boundaries.append(cursor)
        cursor += timedelta(days=7)
    boundaries.append(end)
    if boundaries != sorted(set(boundaries)):
        raise AssertionError("Phase 2 boundaries are not strictly ordered")
    return boundaries


def build_time_index(
    traces: list[dict[str, Any]],
    config: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tc = config["time_contract"]
    timezone = ZoneInfo(tc["timezone"])
    delay = timedelta(days=int(tc["visibility_delay_days"]))
    boundaries = window_boundaries(config)
    phase_start, phase_end = boundaries[0], boundaries[-1]
    valid: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    exclusions: Counter[str] = Counter()
    future_visibility_anomalies: list[str] = []
    by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    trace_by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for trace in traces:
        row, error = trace_visibility(trace, timezone=timezone, delay=delay)
        if error:
            exclusions[error] += 1
            continue
        assert row is not None
        issued_at = parse_datetime(row["ticket_issued_at"], timezone)
        visible_at = parse_datetime(row["visible_at"], timezone)
        if issued_at is None or visible_at is None:
            raise AssertionError("trace_visibility returned an unparseable time")
        if visible_at <= issued_at:
            future_visibility_anomalies.append(row["trace_id"])
        enriched = {
            **row,
            "issued_at_dt": issued_at,
            "visible_at_dt": visible_at,
        }
        trace_id = row["trace_id"]
        if trace_id in by_id:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate train trace ID: {trace_id}")
        valid.append(enriched)
        by_id[trace_id] = enriched
        trace_by_id[trace_id] = trace
    if future_visibility_anomalies:
        raise ValueError(
            f"found {len(future_visibility_anomalies)} traces visible no later than issue time"
        )

    base_ids = sorted(
        row["trace_id"] for row in valid if row["visible_at_dt"] < phase_start
    )
    policy_target_ids = sorted(
        row["trace_id"]
        for row in valid
        if phase_start <= row["issued_at_dt"] < phase_end
        and row["visible_at_dt"] < phase_end
    )
    targets_by_window: list[list[str]] = []
    windows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for index, (start, end) in enumerate(zip(boundaries, boundaries[1:])):
        target_ids = sorted(
            trace_id
            for trace_id in policy_target_ids
            if start <= by_id[trace_id]["issued_at_dt"] < end
        )
        duration_days = (end - start).total_seconds() / 86400.0
        role = "full_natural_week" if duration_days == 7.0 else (
            "left_partial" if index == 0 else "right_partial"
        )
        targets_by_window.append(target_ids)
        windows.append({
            "window_index": index,
            "window_id": f"W{index:02d}",
            "start": start.isoformat(),
            "end": end.isoformat(),
            "duration_days": duration_days,
            "role": role,
            "target_count": len(target_ids),
        })
    if set(policy_target_ids) != {trace_id for rows in targets_by_window for trace_id in rows}:
        raise AssertionError("policy targets are not exactly partitioned by windows")
    return {
        "valid_rows": valid,
        "row_by_id": by_id,
        "trace_by_id": trace_by_id,
        "base_trace_ids": base_ids,
        "policy_target_ids": policy_target_ids,
        "targets_by_window": targets_by_window,
        "windows": windows,
        "boundaries": boundaries,
        "exclusions": dict(sorted(exclusions.items())),
        "counts": {
            "source_trace_count": len(traces),
            "valid_visibility_trace_count": len(valid),
            "base_trace_count": len(base_ids),
            "policy_target_count": len(policy_target_ids),
        },
    }


def eligibility_for_state(state: Any, config: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    mapping = config["compilation"]["use_eligibility"]
    return str(mapping.get(str(state or "draft"), "Review-eligible"))


def compile_version(
    traces: list[dict[str, Any]],
    config: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    started = time.perf_counter()
    authority, authority_manifest = materialize_evidence_authority(traces)
    memories, sidecars = compile_all_with_sidecars(
        authority,
        [],
        risk_traces=authority,
        apply_effect_eligibility=bool(config["compilation"]["effect_eligibility"]),
    )
    lifecycle_transitions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    scores: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for memory in memories:
        old_state = str(memory.get("state") or "draft")
        new_state, rule_id, evidence = evaluate_lifecycle(memory)
        memory["state"] = new_state
        if new_state != old_state:
            lifecycle_transitions.append({
                "memory_id": str(memory.get("memory_id") or ""),
                "memory_type": str(memory.get("memory_type") or ""),
                "from_state": old_state,
                "to_state": new_state,
                "rule_id": rule_id or "TR-AUTO",
                "evidence": evidence,
            })
        score = score_memory(memory)
        if should_promote_reusable(memory, score):
            lifecycle_transitions.append({
                "memory_id": str(memory.get("memory_id") or ""),
                "memory_type": str(memory.get("memory_type") or ""),
                "from_state": str(memory.get("state") or ""),
                "to_state": "reusable",
                "rule_id": "TR-002",
                "evidence": {
                    "overall": score.get("overall"),
                    "support_count": (memory.get("metrics") or {}).get("support_count"),
                    "bayesian_credibility": score.get("bayesian_credibility"),
                },
            })
            memory["state"] = "reusable"
        scores.append(score)
    scores.sort(key=lambda row: str(row.get("memory_id") or ""))
    scores_by_id = {str(row.get("memory_id") or ""): row for row in scores}
    profiles = build_profiles(
        memories,
        scores_by_memory_id=scores_by_id,
        enable_conflict_resolution=True,
        enable_hierarchical_refinement=True,
    )
    profiles.sort(key=lambda row: str(row.get("profile_id") or ""))
    support_profiles = sorted(
        sidecars.get("support_routing_profiles") or [],
        key=lambda row: str(row.get("profile_id") or ""),
    )
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
    return {
        "authority": authority,
        "authority_manifest": authority_manifest,
        "memories": memories,
        "scores": scores,
        "profiles": profiles,
        "support_routing_profiles": support_profiles,
        "lifecycle_transitions": lifecycle_transitions,
        "compile_seconds": elapsed,
    }


def governance_view(
    memories: list[dict[str, Any]],
    profiles: list[dict[str, Any]],
    config: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    profile_by_memory = {
        str(profile.get("parent_memory_id") or ""): profile
        for profile in profiles
        if profile.get("parent_memory_id")
    }
    out: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for memory in memories:
        memory_id = str(memory.get("memory_id") or "")
        profile = profile_by_memory.get(memory_id) or {}
        state = str(memory.get("state") or "draft")
        out[memory_id] = {
            "memory_id": memory_id,
            "memory_type": str(memory.get("memory_type") or ""),
            "evidence_state": str(profile.get("profile_type") or "not_profiled"),
            "lifecycle_state": state,
            "use_eligibility": eligibility_for_state(state, config),
        }
    return out


def governance_delta(
    previous: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    current: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for memory_id in sorted(set(previous) | set(current)):
        before = previous.get(memory_id)
        after = current.get(memory_id)
        if before == after:
            continue
        status = "added" if before is None else "deleted" if after is None else "changed"
        rows.append({
            "memory_id": memory_id,
            "memory_type": str((after or before or {}).get("memory_type") or ""),
            "status": status,
            "before": before,
            "after": after,
            "evidence_state_changed": bool(
                before and after and before["evidence_state"] != after["evidence_state"]
            ),
            "lifecycle_state_changed": bool(
                before and after and before["lifecycle_state"] != after["lifecycle_state"]
            ),
            "use_eligibility_changed": bool(
                before and after and before["use_eligibility"] != after["use_eligibility"]
            ),
        })
    return rows

def process_artifacts(
    *,
    rows_by_artifact: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
    previous_hashes: dict[str, dict[str, str]],
    artifact_specs: list[dict[str, Any]],
    output_dir: Path,
    base: bool,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    current_hashes: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
    reconstructed_hashes: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
    manifests: dict[str, Any] = {}
    full_snapshot_bytes = 0
    stored_payload_bytes = 0
    for spec in artifact_specs:
        name = str(spec["name"])
        id_field = str(spec["id_field"])
        previous = previous_hashes.get(name, {})
        delta = diff_rows(previous, rows_by_artifact[name], id_field=id_field)
        current_hashes[name] = delta["current_hashes"]
        reconstructed = apply_delta_to_hashes(
            previous,
            upserts=delta["upserts"],
            deletes=delta["deletes"],
            id_field=id_field,
        )
        reconstructed_hashes[name] = reconstructed
        if reconstructed != delta["current_hashes"]:
            raise AssertionError(f"hash replay mismatch for {name}")
        full_snapshot_bytes += int(delta["full_snapshot_semantic_bytes"])
        if base:
            upsert_path = output_dir / f"{name}.jsonl"
            delete_artifact = None
        else:
            upsert_path = output_dir / f"{name}.upserts.jsonl"
            delete_artifact = output_dir / f"{name}.deletes.json"
        upsert_artifact = write_jsonl(upsert_path, delta["upserts"])
        stored_payload_bytes += upsert_path.stat().st_size
        delete_manifest = None
        if delete_artifact is not None:
            write_json(delete_artifact, {"id_field": id_field, "ids": delta["deletes"]})
            stored_payload_bytes += delete_artifact.stat().st_size
            delete_manifest = {
                "path": str(delete_artifact.relative_to(ROOT)),
                "count": len(delta["deletes"]),
                "sha256": sha256_path(delete_artifact),
            }
        manifests[name] = {
            "id_field": id_field,
            "counts": delta["counts"],
            "semantic_hash": delta["semantic_hash"],
            "full_snapshot_semantic_bytes": delta["full_snapshot_semantic_bytes"],
            "upserts": upsert_artifact,
            "deletes": delete_manifest,
        }
        del delta
        gc.collect()
    artifact_semantic_hashes = {
        name: artifact_semantic_hash(hashes)
        for name, hashes in current_hashes.items()
    }
    return {
        "current_hashes": current_hashes,
        "reconstructed_hashes": reconstructed_hashes,
        "manifests": manifests,
        "package_semantic_hash": package_semantic_hash(artifact_semantic_hashes),
        "full_snapshot_semantic_bytes": full_snapshot_bytes,
        "stored_payload_bytes": stored_payload_bytes,
    }


def core_manifest_rows(
    trace_ids: list[str],
    *,
    time_index: dict[str, Any],
    authority_by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

        authority_trace = authority_by_id.get(trace_id)
        if authority_trace is None:
            raise AssertionError(f"authority trace missing from version: {trace_id}")
        actions = [
            action for action in authority_trace.get("actions") or [] if isinstance(action, dict)
        ]
        rows.append({

            "last_successful_exec_at": timing["last_successful_exec_at"],
            "visible_at": timing["visible_at"],

            ),

                str(action.get("maximum_attribution_scope") or "") for action in actions
            ).items())),

def feedback_signature(
    *,
    candidate: dict[str, Any],
    target_trace: dict[str, Any],
    memories: list[dict[str, Any]],
    memory_hashes: dict[str, str],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    evidence = _candidate_strategy_evidence(
        candidate["action"],
        target_trace,
        memories,
        selection_policy="structural_relation_v1",
    )
    strategy_ids = [
        str(row.get("memory_id") or "") for row in evidence if row.get("memory_id")
    ]
    source_case_ids = list(candidate["source_case_ids"])
    ordered_ids = source_case_ids + [
        memory_id for memory_id in strategy_ids if memory_id not in source_case_ids
    ]
    missing = [memory_id for memory_id in ordered_ids if memory_id not in memory_hashes]
    if missing:
        raise AssertionError(f"feedback view references missing memories: {missing[:3]}")
    semantic_inputs = [[memory_id, memory_hashes[memory_id]] for memory_id in ordered_ids]
    return {
        "candidate_action_id": candidate["candidate_action_id"],
        "source_case_count": len(source_case_ids),
        "strategy_playbook_count": len(strategy_ids),
        "feedback_semantic_hash": sha256_value({
            "contract": "candidate_feedback_view.v1",
            "candidate_action_id": candidate["candidate_action_id"],
            "ordered_memory_semantics": semantic_inputs,
        }),
    }


def consumer_snapshot(
    *,
    target_traces: list[dict[str, Any]],
    compiled: dict[str, Any],
    memory_hashes: dict[str, str],
    package_hash: str,
    config: dict[str, Any],
) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]:
    cases = [
        memory for memory in compiled["memories"] if memory.get("memory_type") == "case_memory"
    ]
    authority = compiled["authority"]
    pilot_by_trace = {str(trace.get("trace_id") or ""): trace for trace in authority}
    source_actions = {
        (str(trace.get("trace_id") or ""), str(action.get("action_id") or "")): action
        for trace in authority
        for action in trace.get("actions") or []
        if isinstance(action, dict)
    }
    records, postings, case_manifest = precompute_cases(
        cases,
        pilot_by_trace,
        source_actions,
    )
    retrieval_fields = [
        {"query": "issue_type", "applicability": "issue_types", "weight": 8},
        {"query": "vendor", "applicability": "vendors", "weight": 4},
        {"query": "system", "applicability": "systems", "weight": 3},
        {"query": "region", "applicability": "regions", "weight": 2},
        {"query": "band", "applicability": "bands", "weight": 1},
    ]
    queries: dict[tuple[str, ...], dict[str, str]] = {}
    targets_by_key: dict[tuple[str, ...], list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for trace in target_traces:
        query = normalized_query(trace)
        key = query_key(query)
        queries[key] = query
        targets_by_key[key].append(trace)
    pool_by_key: dict[tuple[str, ...], dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for key in sorted(targets_by_key):
        ranked = ranked_positive_case_indices(
            queries[key], records, postings, retrieval_fields
        )
        pool_by_key[key] = build_unique_pool(
            query=queries[key],
            records=records,
            ranked=ranked,
            maximum_unique_pool_size=int(config["consumer_reach"]["candidate_pool_size_k"]),
            memory_sha=package_hash,
            ks=[1, 2, 3, 5, 10],
        )
    rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for trace in target_traces:
        trace_id = str(trace.get("trace_id") or "")
        pool = pool_by_key[query_key(normalized_query(trace))]
        candidates = pool["candidates"]
        feedback = [
            feedback_signature(
                candidate=candidate,
                target_trace=trace,
                memories=compiled["memories"],
                memory_hashes=memory_hashes,
            )
            for candidate in candidates
        ]
        rows[trace_id] = {
            "trace_id": trace_id,
            "candidate_action_ids": [
                candidate["candidate_action_id"] for candidate in candidates
            ],
            "feedback_semantic_hashes": [row["feedback_semantic_hash"] for row in feedback],
            "source_case_counts": [row["source_case_count"] for row in feedback],
            "strategy_playbook_counts": [row["strategy_playbook_count"] for row in feedback],
        }
    return rows, {
        "target_count": len(rows),
        "query_context_count": len(pool_by_key),
        "case_manifest": case_manifest,
        "full_k_target_count": sum(
            len(row["candidate_action_ids"])
            >= int(config["consumer_reach"]["candidate_pool_size_k"])
            for row in rows.values()
        ),
    }


def compare_consumers(
    *,
    static: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    adaptive: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    window: dict[str, Any],
    version_id: str,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for trace_id in sorted(adaptive):
        baseline = static[trace_id]
        current = adaptive[trace_id]
        ordered_changed = baseline["candidate_action_ids"] != current["candidate_action_ids"]
        set_changed = set(baseline["candidate_action_ids"]) != set(current["candidate_action_ids"])
        feedback_changed_ranks = [
            rank
            for rank, (left, right) in enumerate(zip(
                baseline["feedback_semantic_hashes"],
                current["feedback_semantic_hashes"],
            ), start=1)
            if left != right
        ]
        rows.append({
            "trace_id": trace_id,
            "window_id": window["window_id"],
            "adaptive_version_id": version_id,
            "static_candidate_action_ids": baseline["candidate_action_ids"],
            "adaptive_candidate_action_ids": current["candidate_action_ids"],
            "candidate_order_changed": ordered_changed,
            "candidate_set_changed": set_changed,
            "feedback_changed_ranks": feedback_changed_ranks,
            "feedback_changed": bool(feedback_changed_ranks),
            "consumer_reached": bool(ordered_changed or feedback_changed_ranks),
        })
    return rows, {
        "target_count": len(rows),
        "candidate_order_changed": sum(row["candidate_order_changed"] for row in rows),
        "candidate_set_changed": sum(row["candidate_set_changed"] for row in rows),
        "feedback_changed": sum(row["feedback_changed"] for row in rows),
        "consumer_reached": sum(row["consumer_reached"] for row in rows),
    }


def theta_manifest(config_path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    paths = [
        config_path,
        ROOT / "pipeline/compile/compile_rules.py",
        ROOT / "pipeline/compile/outcome_compilation.py",
        ROOT / "pipeline/transition/state.py",
        ROOT / "pipeline/scoring/score.py",
        ROOT / "pipeline/compile/memory_evidence_profiles.py",
        ROOT / "pipeline/package/version_delta.py",
        ROOT / "pipeline/evaluation/candidate_identity.py",
        ROOT / "pipeline/evaluation/retrieval_baselines.py",
        ROOT / "data/raw/action_ontology/action_ontology_reviewed_draft_v2.json",
    ]
    files = [
        {"path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": sha256_path(path)}
        for path in paths
        if path.exists()
    ]
    return {"files": files, "theta_hash": sha256_value(files)}


def reconstruct_final_from_disk(
    *,
    base_dir: Path,
    version_dirs: list[Path],
    artifact_specs: list[dict[str, Any]],
    expected_hashes: dict[str, dict[str, str]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    started = time.perf_counter()
    results: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for spec in artifact_specs:
        name = str(spec["name"])
        id_field = str(spec["id_field"])
        rows = index_rows(cio.read_jsonl(base_dir / f"{name}.jsonl"), id_field=id_field)
        for version_dir in version_dirs:
            delete_payload = read_json(version_dir / f"{name}.deletes.json")
            for row_id in delete_payload["ids"]:
                rows.pop(str(row_id), None)
            for row_id, row in index_rows(
                cio.read_jsonl(version_dir / f"{name}.upserts.jsonl"),
                id_field=id_field,
            ).items():
                rows[row_id] = row
        actual = hash_index(rows)
        if actual != expected_hashes[name]:
            raise AssertionError(f"full disk reconstruction mismatch for {name}")
        results[name] = {
            "row_count": len(rows),
            "semantic_hash": artifact_semantic_hash(actual),
        }
        del rows, actual
        gc.collect()
    return {
        "seconds": time.perf_counter() - started,
        "artifacts": results,
        "all_passed": True,
    }


def format_bytes(value: int | float) -> str:
    size = float(value)
    for unit in ("B", "KiB", "MiB", "GiB", "TiB"):
        if size < 1024.0 or unit == "TiB":
            return f"{size:.2f} {unit}"
        size /= 1024.0
    return f"{size:.2f} TiB"


def percent(value: Any) -> str:
    return "N/A" if value is None else f"{100.0 * float(value):.2f}%"

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_CONFIG)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config_path = args.config if args.config.is_absolute() else ROOT / args.config
    config = read_json(config_path)
    source_path = project_path(config["source"]["train_trace_records"])
    if any(token in str(source_path).lower() for token in ("dev", "holdout", "test")):
        raise ValueError(f"Phase 2 refuses non-train source: {source_path}")
    phase1_path = project_path(config["depends_on"]["phase1_unique_pool_summary"])
    phase1 = read_json(phase1_path)
    if phase1["selection"]["selected_candidate_pool_size_k"] != int(
        config["depends_on"]["candidate_pool_size_k"]
    ):
        raise ValueError("Phase 2 K differs from frozen Phase 1 selection")
    if phase1["sources"]["train_trace_records"]["sha256"] != sha256_path(source_path):
        raise ValueError("train source changed after Phase 1 freeze")

    traces = list(cio.read_jsonl(source_path))
    time_index = build_time_index(traces, config)
    if time_index["counts"]["base_trace_count"] != phase1["temporal_view"]["counts"]["pilot_build_history_count"]:
        raise ValueError("Phase 2 base history differs from Phase 1 Pilot history")
    if time_index["counts"]["policy_target_count"] != phase1["temporal_view"]["counts"]["policy_development_visible_count"]:
        raise ValueError("Phase 2 policy target population differs from Phase 1")

    output_dir = project_path(config["outputs"]["result_dir"])
    base_dir = output_dir / "base"
    versions_dir = output_dir / "versions"
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    theta = theta_manifest(config_path)
    artifact_specs = config["delta"]["materialized_artifacts"]
    trace_by_id = time_index["trace_by_id"]
    row_by_id = time_index["row_by_id"]
    boundaries = time_index["boundaries"]

    base_history = [trace_by_id[trace_id] for trace_id in time_index["base_trace_ids"]]
    print(f"compiling base history: {len(base_history)} traces", flush=True)
    compiled = compile_version(base_history, config)
    authority_by_id = {
        str(trace.get("trace_id") or ""): trace for trace in compiled["authority"]
    }
    base_core_rows = core_manifest_rows(
        time_index["base_trace_ids"],
        time_index=time_index,
        authority_by_id=authority_by_id,
    )
    base_core_artifact = write_jsonl(base_dir / "core_history_manifest.jsonl", base_core_rows)
    processed = process_artifacts(
        rows_by_artifact=artifact_rows(compiled),
        previous_hashes={},
        artifact_specs=artifact_specs,
        output_dir=base_dir,
        base=True,
    )
    previous_hashes = processed["current_hashes"]
    reconstructed_hashes = processed["reconstructed_hashes"]
    if previous_hashes != reconstructed_hashes:
        raise AssertionError("base hash reconstruction failed")
    previous_governance = governance_view(compiled["memories"], compiled["profiles"], config)
    base_governance_artifact = write_jsonl(
        base_dir / "governance_view.jsonl",
        previous_governance.values(),
    )
    base_version_hash = version_chain_hash(
        previous_version_hash="GENESIS",
        core_delta_hash=base_core_artifact["sha256"],
        materialization_delta_hash=processed["package_semantic_hash"],
        theta_hash=theta["theta_hash"],
        evidence_cutoff=boundaries[0].isoformat(),
    )
    base_manifest = {
        "version_id": "P00_BASE",
        "evidence_cutoff": boundaries[0].isoformat(),
        "history_trace_count": len(base_history),
        "core_history": base_core_artifact,
        "artifacts": processed["manifests"],
        "governance_view": base_governance_artifact,
        "package_semantic_hash": processed["package_semantic_hash"],
        "version_hash": base_version_hash,
        "theta": theta,
        "compile_seconds": compiled["compile_seconds"],
    }
    write_json(base_dir / "manifest.json", base_manifest)
    all_full_snapshot_bytes = processed["full_snapshot_semantic_bytes"]
    artifact_payload_bytes = processed["stored_payload_bytes"] + (base_dir / "core_history_manifest.jsonl").stat().st_size

    all_target_traces = [
        trace_by_id[trace_id] for trace_id in time_index["policy_target_ids"]
    ]
    print(f"building static consumer snapshot: {len(all_target_traces)} targets", flush=True)
    static_consumers, static_consumer_manifest = consumer_snapshot(
        target_traces=all_target_traces,
        compiled=compiled,
        memory_hashes=previous_hashes["memory_objects"],
        package_hash=processed["package_semantic_hash"],
        config=config,
    )

    consumer_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    version_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    base_window_targets = [
        trace_by_id[trace_id] for trace_id in time_index["targets_by_window"][0]
    ]
    base_adaptive = {str(trace.get("trace_id") or ""): static_consumers[str(trace.get("trace_id") or "")] for trace in base_window_targets}
    base_reach_rows, base_reach = compare_consumers(
        static=static_consumers,
        adaptive=base_adaptive,
        window=time_index["windows"][0],
        version_id="P00_BASE",
    )
    consumer_rows.extend(base_reach_rows)
    version_rows.append({
        "version_id": "P00_BASE",
        "parent_version_id": None,
        "evidence_cutoff": boundaries[0].isoformat(),
        "history_trace_count": len(base_history),
        "core_delta_trace_count": len(base_history),
        "memory_object_count": len(compiled["memories"]),
        "memory_object_upsert_count": len(compiled["memories"]),
        "governance_changes": {
            "added": len(previous_governance),
            "deleted": 0,
            "evidence_state_changed": 0,
            "lifecycle_state_changed": 0,
            "use_eligibility_changed": 0,
        },
        "consumer_reach": base_reach,
        "compile_seconds": compiled["compile_seconds"],
        "semantic_equivalence": True,
        "version_hash": base_version_hash,
    })
    previous_version_hash = base_version_hash
    previous_boundary = boundaries[0]
    version_output_dirs: list[Path] = []
    all_versions_equivalent = True

    del base_history, base_core_rows, authority_by_id, processed
    del compiled
    gc.collect()

    for version_index, boundary in enumerate(boundaries[1:], start=1):
        version_id = f"P{version_index:02d}_{boundary.strftime('%Y%m%d')}"
        version_dir = versions_dir / version_id
        version_output_dirs.append(version_dir)
        history_ids = sorted(
            row["trace_id"]
            for row in time_index["valid_rows"]
            if row["visible_at_dt"] < boundary
        )
        delta_ids = sorted(
            row["trace_id"]
            for row in time_index["valid_rows"]
            if previous_boundary <= row["visible_at_dt"] < boundary
        )
        history = [trace_by_id[trace_id] for trace_id in history_ids]
        print(
            f"compiling {version_id}: history={len(history_ids)} new_visible={len(delta_ids)}",
            flush=True,
        )
        compiled = compile_version(history, config)
        authority_by_id = {
            str(trace.get("trace_id") or ""): trace for trace in compiled["authority"]
        }
        core_rows = core_manifest_rows(
            delta_ids,
            time_index=time_index,
            authority_by_id=authority_by_id,
        )
        core_artifact = write_jsonl(version_dir / "core_delta.jsonl", core_rows)
        processed = process_artifacts(
            rows_by_artifact=artifact_rows(compiled),
            previous_hashes=previous_hashes,
            artifact_specs=artifact_specs,
            output_dir=version_dir,
            base=False,
        )
        reconstructed_hashes = {
            name: apply_delta_to_hashes(
                previous_hashes.get(name, {}),
                upserts=list(cio.read_jsonl(version_dir / f"{name}.upserts.jsonl")),
                deletes=read_json(version_dir / f"{name}.deletes.json")["ids"],
                id_field=str(next(spec["id_field"] for spec in artifact_specs if spec["name"] == name)),
            )
            for name in processed["current_hashes"]
        }
        equivalent = reconstructed_hashes == processed["current_hashes"]
        all_versions_equivalent = all_versions_equivalent and equivalent
        if not equivalent:
            raise AssertionError(f"semantic delta replay failed for {version_id}")

        current_governance = governance_view(compiled["memories"], compiled["profiles"], config)
        state_delta = governance_delta(previous_governance, current_governance)
        state_artifact = write_jsonl(version_dir / "state_delta.jsonl", state_delta)
        state_counts = {
            "added": sum(row["status"] == "added" for row in state_delta),
            "deleted": sum(row["status"] == "deleted" for row in state_delta),
            "evidence_state_changed": sum(row["evidence_state_changed"] for row in state_delta),
            "lifecycle_state_changed": sum(row["lifecycle_state_changed"] for row in state_delta),
            "use_eligibility_changed": sum(row["use_eligibility_changed"] for row in state_delta),
        }
        materialization_delta_hash = sha256_value({
            "artifact_manifests": processed["manifests"],
            "state_delta_sha256": state_artifact["sha256"],
        })
        current_version_hash = version_chain_hash(
            previous_version_hash=previous_version_hash,
            core_delta_hash=core_artifact["sha256"],
            materialization_delta_hash=materialization_delta_hash,
            theta_hash=theta["theta_hash"],
            evidence_cutoff=boundary.isoformat(),
        )

        window_index = version_index
        if window_index < len(time_index["windows"]):
            target_ids = time_index["targets_by_window"][window_index]
            target_traces = [trace_by_id[trace_id] for trace_id in target_ids]
            print(
                f"building adaptive consumer snapshot {version_id}: {len(target_traces)} targets",
                flush=True,
            )
            adaptive_consumers, adaptive_manifest = consumer_snapshot(
                target_traces=target_traces,
                compiled=compiled,
                memory_hashes=processed["current_hashes"]["memory_objects"],
                package_hash=processed["package_semantic_hash"],
                config=config,
            )
            reach_rows, reach = compare_consumers(
                static=static_consumers,
                adaptive=adaptive_consumers,
                window=time_index["windows"][window_index],
                version_id=version_id,
            )
            consumer_rows.extend(reach_rows)
        else:
            adaptive_manifest = {"target_count": 0, "query_context_count": 0}
            reach = {
                "target_count": 0,
                "candidate_order_changed": 0,
                "candidate_set_changed": 0,
                "feedback_changed": 0,
                "consumer_reached": 0,
            }

        manifest = {
            "version_id": version_id,
            "parent_version_id": version_rows[-1]["version_id"],
            "evidence_cutoff": boundary.isoformat(),
            "history_trace_count": len(history_ids),
            "core_delta": core_artifact,
            "core_delta_trace_count": len(delta_ids),
            "authority_manifest": compiled["authority_manifest"],
            "artifacts": processed["manifests"],
            "state_delta": state_artifact,
            "state_delta_counts": state_counts,
            "consumer_manifest": adaptive_manifest,
            "consumer_reach": reach,
            "full_compile_package_semantic_hash": processed["package_semantic_hash"],
            "reconstructed_package_semantic_hash": package_semantic_hash({
                name: artifact_semantic_hash(hashes)
                for name, hashes in reconstructed_hashes.items()
            }),
            "semantic_equivalence": equivalent,
            "previous_version_hash": previous_version_hash,
            "materialization_delta_hash": materialization_delta_hash,
            "theta_hash": theta["theta_hash"],
            "version_hash": current_version_hash,
            "compile_seconds": compiled["compile_seconds"],
        }
        write_json(version_dir / "manifest.json", manifest)
        version_rows.append({
            "version_id": version_id,
            "parent_version_id": manifest["parent_version_id"],
            "evidence_cutoff": boundary.isoformat(),
            "history_trace_count": len(history_ids),
            "core_delta_trace_count": len(delta_ids),
            "memory_object_count": len(compiled["memories"]),
            "memory_object_upsert_count": processed["manifests"]["memory_objects"]["counts"]["upserts"],
            "governance_changes": state_counts,
            "consumer_reach": reach,
            "compile_seconds": compiled["compile_seconds"],
            "semantic_equivalence": equivalent,
            "version_hash": current_version_hash,
        })
        all_full_snapshot_bytes += processed["full_snapshot_semantic_bytes"]
        artifact_payload_bytes += processed["stored_payload_bytes"] + (version_dir / "core_delta.jsonl").stat().st_size
        previous_hashes = processed["current_hashes"]
        previous_governance = current_governance
        previous_version_hash = current_version_hash
        previous_boundary = boundary

        del history, compiled, authority_by_id, core_rows, state_delta, processed
        gc.collect()

    consumer_artifact = write_jsonl(output_dir / "consumer_reach.jsonl", consumer_rows)
    versions_artifact = write_jsonl(output_dir / "version_summary.jsonl", version_rows)
    final_reconstruction = reconstruct_final_from_disk(
        base_dir=base_dir,
        version_dirs=version_output_dirs,
        artifact_specs=artifact_specs,
        expected_hashes=previous_hashes,
    )
    all_files_bytes = sum(
        path.stat().st_size for path in output_dir.rglob("*") if path.is_file()
    )
    reach_totals = {
        "target_count": len(consumer_rows),
        "candidate_order_changed": sum(row["candidate_order_changed"] for row in consumer_rows),
        "candidate_set_changed": sum(row["candidate_set_changed"] for row in consumer_rows),
        "feedback_changed": sum(row["feedback_changed"] for row in consumer_rows),
        "consumer_reached": sum(row["consumer_reached"] for row in consumer_rows),
    }
    reach_totals["consumer_reach_rate"] = (
        reach_totals["consumer_reached"] / reach_totals["target_count"]
        if reach_totals["target_count"]
        else None
    )
    changed_governance = sum(
        row["governance_changes"]["evidence_state_changed"]
        + row["governance_changes"]["lifecycle_state_changed"]
        + row["governance_changes"]["use_eligibility_changed"]
        for row in version_rows[1:]
    )
    storage = {
        "all_full_snapshots_semantic_bytes": all_full_snapshot_bytes,
        "base_plus_delta_artifact_payload_bytes": artifact_payload_bytes,
        "base_plus_delta_all_files_bytes": all_files_bytes,
        "artifact_payload_storage_ratio": (
            artifact_payload_bytes / all_full_snapshot_bytes if all_full_snapshot_bytes else None
        ),
        "all_files_storage_ratio": (
            all_files_bytes / all_full_snapshot_bytes if all_full_snapshot_bytes else None
        ),
    }
    gate_config = config["feasibility_gate"]
    checks = {
        "semantic_equivalence": all_versions_equivalent
        and final_reconstruction["all_passed"],
        "storage_ratio": float(storage["all_files_storage_ratio"] or 999.0)
        <= float(gate_config["storage_ratio_max"]),
        "governance_change": changed_governance
        >= int(gate_config["minimum_changed_governance_object_count"]),
        "consumer_reach": reach_totals["consumer_reached"]
        >= int(gate_config["minimum_candidate_or_feedback_reached_target_count"]),
        "no_dev_or_holdout": True,
        "no_agent_output_in_delta": True,
    }
    feasibility = {
        "status": "phase2_feasibility_passed" if all(checks.values()) else "phase2_feasibility_no_go",
        "checks": checks,
        "changed_governance_signal_count": changed_governance,
    }
    summary = {
        "schema_version": config["schema_version"],
        "protocol_version": config["protocol_version"],
        "delta_contract": config["delta_contract"],
        "created_at": datetime.now(tz=ZoneInfo(config["time_contract"]["timezone"])).isoformat(),
        "git_head": git_head(),
        "sources": {
            "train_trace_records": {
                "path": str(source_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
                "sha256": sha256_path(source_path),
            },
            "phase1_unique_pool_summary": {
                "path": str(phase1_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
                "sha256": sha256_path(phase1_path),
            },
            "config": {
                "path": str(config_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
                "sha256": sha256_path(config_path),
            },
            "exporter": {
                "path": str(Path(__file__).resolve().relative_to(ROOT)),
                "sha256": sha256_path(Path(__file__).resolve()),
            },
            "theta": theta,
        },
        "time_view": {
            "counts": time_index["counts"],
            "exclusions": time_index["exclusions"],
            "windows": time_index["windows"],
            "base_trace_id_manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                "\n".join(time_index["base_trace_ids"]).encode("utf-8")
            ).hexdigest(),
            "policy_target_id_manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                "\n".join(time_index["policy_target_ids"]).encode("utf-8")
            ).hexdigest(),
        },
        "base": base_manifest,
        "versions": version_rows,
        "storage": storage,
        "semantic_equivalence": {
            "all_versions_passed": all_versions_equivalent,
            "final_disk_reconstruction": final_reconstruction,
        },
        "consumer_reach": reach_totals,
        "static_consumer_manifest": static_consumer_manifest,
        "feasibility_gate": feasibility,
        "integrity": {
            "dev_or_holdout_loaded": False,
            "agent_called": False,
            "gold_or_target_outcome_read_for_consumer_generation": False,
            "policy_targets_partitioned_once": len(consumer_rows)
            == len(time_index["policy_target_ids"]),
            "hash_chain_terminal": previous_version_hash,
        },
        "artifacts": {
            "base_manifest": {

        "claim_boundary": (
            "Incremental package storage and exact semantic reconstruction under frozen cumulative full compilation; "

    write_json(output_dir / "summary.json", summary)
    retained_path = project_path(config["outputs"]["retained_summary"])

    report_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
